description: This PHP source file defines a class `SugarWidgetSubPanelTopScheduleMeetingButton` that extends a quick create button class to generate a form/button for scheduling meetings from a subpanel. It manages form creation with hidden fields and scripts, and controls display based on access rights.

classes.name: SugarWidgetSubPanelTopScheduleMeetingButton
classes.description: A widget class for rendering a 'Schedule Meeting' button in a subpanel, allowing quick creation of Meeting records.

methods.name: _get_form
methods.description: Generates an HTML form string with hidden fields and scripts to facilitate scheduling a meeting from a subpanel, including context-specific data and scripts.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Displays the button if the user has edit access to the focus bean; otherwise, returns an empty string.
